refers to the following Vedic deities:
questions.explanation:
The Boghaz Koi Inscription from asia minor
refers to vedic deities Indra, mitra, varuna and Nasatyas.

certain contracts between king of Hittites (in persia) and
the king of mitani. In this Inscription Indra, Varuna,
Mitra and Nasatya are mentioned as the protectors of
contracts.
